questions: Has he worked on predictive maintenance?
faqs.answer: SentinelIQ is a live predictive-maintenance portfolio project built around remaining-useful-life estimation, dual anomaly detection, SHAP attribution, and intervention scheduling. The portfolio avoids a winning-model, RMSE, savings, or operational-benefit claim because those metrics are not published as verified evidence.
